title: Warm, clear, in a minute
goal: Trust AI to draft a sensitive parent message — while you own the tone and keep private details out.

blocks.title: The email you keep putting off
blocks.body:
There's a message sitting in the back of your mind — the one to the parent about a tricky situation. You've rewritten the first line five times and closed the laptop twice.

Here's the good news: this is exactly where AI helps most. It gives you a calm first draft in a minute, so you're editing instead of staring at a blank screen. You stay the one who decides how it lands.

blocks.title: Situation, tone, outcome — no names
blocks.body:
A good parent message needs three things, and you can hand all three to AI:

1. The situation — what happened, in plain words.
2. The tone you want — warm, reassuring, firm-but-kind.
3. The outcome — what you hope the parent does next.

One rule stays with you: keep students' names and private details out of the box. Describe "a student in my class", never "Rohan, who is on medication". Free AI tools aren't a private staffroom — so you de-identify first, then let AI draft.
blocks.goDeeper: Why leave names out? Anything you type into a free AI tool may be stored or used to train it. A situation described as "a student who has been missing homework" gets you the same warm draft — with none of the child's privacy handed away.

blocks.question: A child has been disruptive in class and you're writing to the parent. Which opening line lands as respectful, not defensive?

options.text: I need to talk to you about your son's behaviour problem.
I wanted to share something I've noticed lately, and work together with you on it.
Your son has been a constant distraction in my class.

blocks.explanation: You spotted it — the collaborative opener invites the parent onto your side. The other two put them on the defensive before they've read a word. That instinct for tone is exactly what you bring that AI can't.

blocks.template: Rewrite the situation for AI without leaking anything private: "{{who}} {{detail}} — help me write a warm note to their parent."

options: has been missing homework this week
has been missing homework because of his counselling sessions

blocks.question: How comfortable do you feel letting AI draft a sensitive parent message — with you keeping the names and the tone in your own hands?
